name: 免费模型超市
description_zh: 免费大模型 API 超市。维护 41 家厂商的免费模型渠道数据（额度、限速、端点、状态、信源），提供按场景选型推荐引擎、配置排障（doctor）与货架巡检优化（watch）闭环。当用户询问有哪些免费大模型 API 可用、推荐免费模型、查询某厂商免费额度，或需要巡检更新免费模型货架时使用。
description_en: Free LLM API marketplace. Maintains free-tier model data across 41 providers (quotas, rate limits, endpoints, status, sources), offering a scenario-based recommendation engine, config doctor, and catalog watch/optimization loop. Use when users ask about available free LLM APIs, free model suggestions, provider free-tier quotas, or need to refresh the catalog.
